snippet.title: Manafinder II - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist today and learn more on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4568010/Manafinder_II

Mankind has ended, yet the world moved on. Take the role of Rey in this turn-based RPG and fight ferocious beasts and other existential threats alongside a disparate cast of allies as you seek a new purpose in a world that no longer welcomes you.

Manafinder II is in development for PC and is expected to be released in early 2027.

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4568010/Manafinder_II
Official Website: https://manafinderii.com
Follow us on Twitter:   https://twitter.com/manafinder 
Follow us on Instagram:   https://www.instagram.com/manafinder/
Follow us on TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@wolfsden.games

And don't forget to like and subscribe! 

#manafinder #rpg #turnbasedrpg
